baseline_models.reading: ʿĀd and Thamūd are presented as cases already made clear to the addressees through their dwellings. Satan made their intentional deeds appear beautiful and consequently diverted them from the way, although they possessed discernment.

focus_anchor.quote_ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
focus_anchor.role: The complete focus presents both the externally evident case and the internal paradox of attractive deeds, diversion, and continuing discernment.

activation_trace.role: The image of something appearing and becoming clear grounds the addressees' attained clarity.
The dwelling and settlement image supplies the material source from which the case is inferred.
Making beauty show distinguishes attractive presentation from inherent goodness.
The rebellious, devilish agent supplies the personal source of the deceptive presentation.
The intentional-doing image makes the beautified objects their own chosen acts.
The image covers both blocking another and turning that person aside.
The extended traversable way supplies the goal from which they were diverted.
Inner sight and verified awareness ground the claim that they were not simply devoid of cognition.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ
structural_cues.role: قَد with the perfect presents clarity as already available, while مِن locates its evidentiary source in the dwellings.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
structural_cues.role: The فـ makes diversion follow beautification, while the final state-clause places discernment beside the failure to follow the way.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus contrasts retrospective visibility for the addressees with ineffective insight in the earlier people. Deceptive beautification works by corrupting evaluation, so possession of sight does not itself determine direction.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarity, dwellings, displayed beauty, intentional work, diversion, a way, and inner sight. No context assumption is needed for this baseline. The reader supplies the ordinary concessive force of the final coordination and reads ٱلسَّبِيلِ as a moral course; a merely coordinative reading and a broader practical route remain grammatically possible. The missing governor of the opening accusatives leaves the exact event involving the two peoples underdetermined in the focus alone.
baseline_models.containment: Retain this as the ordinary reading without specifying the particular deeds, the psychology or mode of Satanic influence, the precise degree of their insight, or the exact consequence visible in the dwellings.

context_deltas.reading: The opening trial sequence makes the focus's discernment an ethically unratified capacity: professions and perceptions become truthful only when they govern conduct under pressure, and human affliction can distort the scale by which consequences are judged.

focus_anchor.role: The final description of discernment is what the earlier testing sequence sharpens.

activation_trace.role: The inner-sight image identifies the cognitive capacity that failed to govern direction.
The assaying-by-trial image makes a verbal profession subject to proof.
The confirmation and fulfillment image presents truth as realized rather than merely claimed.
The ordeal image shows human harm becoming a competing evaluative pressure.

structural_cues.quote_ar: أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ
structural_cues.role: The question denies that saying one believes is sufficient without testing.

structural_cues.quote_ar: فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
structural_cues.role: The paired outcomes distinguish realized truthfulness from false profession.

structural_cues.quote_ar: فَإِذَآ أُوذِىَ فِى ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ
structural_cues.role: The comparison displays a failure to rank unlike pressures correctly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from claimed assent through testing to revealed conduct. That sequence converts the focus's paradox from simple ignorance into insight that has not survived evaluative pressure.

changed_reading.before: They possessed insight yet were nevertheless diverted.
changed_reading.after: They possessed cognition that did not become tested fidelity; the failure lay in how pressure was valued and acted upon, not simply in absence of information.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies profession, testing, truthful realization, falsehood, and the miscomparison of two afflictions. The reader maps that pattern onto مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ. A live alternative is that the focus describes practical or worldly intelligence unrelated to the earlier faith tests.
context_deltas.containment: Do not erase the focus's positive assertion that they had discernment, and do not treat every hardship as proof of false faith. Present the context as sharpening the knowledge-action gap.

context_deltas.reading: The unqualified أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ is not evil merely because it is called work. Repeated contrasts between works joined to السيئات and works joined to الصالحات show that Satanic beautification is an evaluative misclassification: felt attractiveness can mask the difference between corrupt and sound action.

focus_anchor.role: The otherwise unqualified noun for their deeds receives moral differentiation from repeated contextual collocations.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies intentional action without building moral value into the noun itself.
Making beauty appear explains how apparent value can diverge from actual value.
Badness and ugliness explicitly qualify one class of performed acts.
Soundness against corruption explicitly qualifies the contrasting class of acts.

structural_cues.quote_ar: يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ
structural_cues.role: Work is directly joined to evil acts.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ
structural_cues.role: The same work vocabulary is directly joined to sound acts.

structural_cues.quote_ar: أَحْسَنَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
structural_cues.role: The outcome evaluates performed work by a standard beyond subjective attractiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated qualification controls the focus's bare noun: work is morally open until its alignment is established. Beautification deceives by making one evaluative category look like the other.

changed_reading.before: Their deeds as a single block were made attractive.
changed_reading.after: Their intentional acts were made to appear worthy despite the chapter's explicit distinction between corrupt and sound work; attractiveness is not evidence of soundness.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet expressly supplies intentional work and the opposed qualifications السيئات and الصالحات. The reader applies those contrasts to the focus's unqualified noun. A live alternative is that some of أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ denotes worldly projects or customary activities, but the intentional-doing branch still leaves their value to be assessed.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer the exact content of their deeds or claim that every attractive act is corrupt. The claim is only that the focus separates attractive presentation from moral quality.

context_deltas.reading: Diversion from the way can be socially voiced: human speakers invite others to follow their own path and offer a false transfer of culpability. The context therefore supplies a human channel for deception while preserving both the follower's liability and an added burden for the misleading party.

focus_anchor.role: The focus's blocking from the way is re-read through an explicit social invitation to a rival way.

activation_trace.role: The blocking and diversion image supplies the focus-side action.
Following a person, command, or course supplies the social recruitment mechanism.
Bearing responsibility or sin is the image exploited by the speakers' false promise.
Culpable wrongdoing is the liability the speakers claim they can transfer.
The repeated heaviness image makes responsibility cumulative rather than removable by rhetoric.

structural_cues.quote_ar: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَٰيَٰكُمْ
structural_cues.role: The imperative joins rival-path recruitment to a promised indemnity.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَمَا هُم بِحَٰمِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَٰيَٰهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
structural_cues.role: The promise is categorically denied and named false.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًۭا مَّعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ
structural_cues.role: The promised removal is reversed into their own burden plus additional burdens.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rival way is made appealing through interpersonal speech and an impossible promise that consequences can be outsourced. This concretizes how beautification and blocking may enter a social network.

changed_reading.before: Satanic diversion appears as a general, unspecified influence.
changed_reading.after: The influence can operate through persuasive human invitations and false assurances about responsibility, without turning either guides or followers into consequence-free instruments.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The invitation, false burden claim, and cumulative burdens are packet-supplied. The reader identifies this rhetoric as a possible channel of the focus's Satanic diversion; it could instead be an independent parallel example. Nothing in the packet says that Satan literally uttered the speakers' words.
context_deltas.containment: Qualify the social mechanism as an activation, not an identification of the speakers with ʿĀd or Thamūd. Do not imply that followers lose their own responsibility or that the additional burdens are exhaustively explained here.

context_deltas.reading: The clarity arising from the dwellings becomes a disciplined material inference: the chapter commands movement through the earth and reflective looking, then describes a deliberately retained clear sign for people who reason.

focus_anchor.role: The phrase locates clarity in something available from the former dwellings.

activation_trace.role: Becoming visibly clear supplies the inference's result.
Dwellings provide the physical locus of the evidence.
Directed sight and reflective examination supply the method of observation.
Leaving an effect to remain supplies the persistence of a trace after its owners have gone.
The visible-sign image identifies the retained trace as evidence.
Understanding as restraint and discernment makes the trace something to reason from, not merely view.

structural_cues.quote_ar: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ
structural_cues.role: Imperatives to travel and look establish an observational posture toward material creation.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
structural_cues.role: A trace is expressly left as a clear sign whose force depends on reasoning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel, looking, a retained sign, and reasoning form an evidentiary chain that sharpens مِن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ from a bare source phrase into inference from surviving material traces.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings simply supply a fact already clear to the addressees.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings function as inspectable traces within a practice of moving, looking, and reasoning from what has deliberately been left visible.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The observational imperative and the retained clear sign are explicit. The reader generalizes their method to the focus's dwellings; 29:20 directly concerns creation's beginning and 29:35 directly concerns a different settlement, so their immediate referents remain distinct. The branchless ك ي ف in 29:20 is used only as structural Arabic evidence.
context_deltas.containment: Do not claim a particular archaeological site, travel route, architectural feature, or scientific procedure. State only that the context authorizes material observation as a mode of admonitory inference.

context_deltas.reading: The immediate sequence resolves the opening names into a distributive catalogue of accountable downfall: denials and arrogance precede seizures, 29:40 gathers each case under its own sin, and the closing clause denies divine wrongdoing. Satanic beautification is therefore an influence within, not a cancellation of, self-involving responsibility.

focus_anchor.role: The bare accusative names occupy the middle of the catalogue that the following distributive clause closes.

activation_trace.role: The rebellious tempter supplies one causal level without grammatically erasing the people's own acts.
Seizure immediately following rejection establishes the catalogue's punitive pattern.
Self-exaltation and refusal to submit to truth supply an internally attributed response to clear proofs.
The repeated taking image gathers the differentiated punishments into one accountable pattern.
Sin as culpable consequence explicitly connects each seizure to its subject's wrongdoing.

structural_cues.quote_ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
structural_cues.role: The preceding case supplies rejection, seizure, and the resulting state in the home.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
structural_cues.role: The focus supplies deceptive influence and the people's own works inside the catalogue.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَقَٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ
structural_cues.role: The following names continue the accusative list and add clear proofs followed by arrogance.

structural_cues.quote_ar: فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنۢبِهِۦ
structural_cues.role: The distributive كُلًّا supplies the list's governing closure and individual ground of seizure.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
structural_cues.role: The concluding reversal attributes wrongdoing to the people themselves rather than to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is syntactically enclosed by parallel named cases and then collected by فَكُلًّا. That list closure specifies the underdetermined opening and coordinates external temptation with personal culpability.

changed_reading.before: The focus alone names ʿĀd and Thamūd and leaves the precise event governing the accusatives implicit.
changed_reading.after: They are members of a sequence in which each is seized for its own sin; their visible case is punitive and self-involving rather than arbitrary.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The sequence, accusative list, distributive كُلًّا, sin, and self-wronging are packet-supplied. The reader treats 29:40 as resolving the focus's ellipsis and treats Satanic and personal causation as compatible levels. A bare remembered or mentioned construction remains a formal alternative for the omitted verb, but the immediate closure strongly favors inclusion in the seizure catalogue.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer the exact form of punishment for ʿĀd or Thamūd from 29:38 itself. Preserve both Satanic mediation and personal responsibility without converting either into determinism.

context_deltas.reading: Later epistemic contrasts sharpen مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ into possessed but non-governing knowledge. Parables require disciplined understanding, clear signs can be borne in knowledgeable breasts yet knowingly denied, and a correct answer about the Creator can coexist with being turned away.

focus_anchor.role: The focus's inner-sight description is differentiated from reasoning, internalized signs, acknowledgement, and actual direction.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight supplies real cognitive access without itself entailing obedience.
Understanding as discerning restraint marks a more active reception of a parable.
Knowing denial supplies the possibility of rejecting what inwardly available knowledge supports.
Turning something from its proper direction closely parallels the focus's blocked way after a correct verbal answer.
The explicit failure to reason distinguishes acknowledgement from disciplined understanding.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ ۖ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْعَٰلِمُونَ
structural_cues.role: The verse joins knowledge to active comprehension of an analogy.

structural_cues.quote_ar: بَلْ هُوَ ءَايَٰتٌۢ بَيِّنَٰتٌۭ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
structural_cues.role: Clear signs are placed inwardly, yet the same sentence retains the possibility of denial.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
structural_cues.role: A correct creator-confession is immediately followed by the question of directional inversion.

structural_cues.quote_ar: بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
structural_cues.role: The failure is located not in the absence of an answer but in failure to reason from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence separates access to signs, correct propositions, knowing denial, and action-guiding reason. That separation explains how real discernment can coexist with diversion.

changed_reading.before: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ states the paradoxical survival of insight alongside misdirection.
changed_reading.after: Their insight can be read as available or even acknowledged truth that became self-incriminating because it was not converted into reasoned adherence.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inner sight, reasoning, inward clear signs, knowing denial, correct acknowledgement, and directional turning. The reader synthesizes these unnamed groups typologically rather than identifying them historically with ʿĀd and Thamūd. A live alternative is that مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ primarily describes worldly shrewdness or practical observational skill.
context_deltas.containment: Do not collapse sight, knowledge, reason, faith, and guidance into synonyms. Present the context as differentiating them and heightening the focus's paradox, not as fixing one exclusive gloss.

context_deltas.reading: The focus's causal chain of beautified action followed by diversion acquires a practical counter-pattern: established prayer is said to restrain gross and condemned action, while what people make remains under divine knowledge.

focus_anchor.quote_ar: وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
focus_anchor.role: This is the action-forming sequence that the later restraining practice reverses.

activation_trace.role: Displayed attractiveness supplies the force that encourages corrupt action.
Diversion supplies the resulting loss of direction.
The prescribed-worship image supplies an embodied practice rather than bare cognition.
Restraint from an act directly reverses the momentum generated by beautification.
The condemned act that ought to be checked supplies the practice's moral object.

structural_cues.quote_ar: إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ
structural_cues.role: Prayer is grammatically assigned a restraining effect on corrupt conduct.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ
structural_cues.role: The closing statement returns from practice to accountable human making.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verbs form an inverse pair: beautification propels action toward blockage, while prayer restrains actions that would embody that misvaluation.

changed_reading.before: The focus diagnoses how attractive deeds can carry perceptive people away from the way.
changed_reading.after: The diagnosis also implies a counter-formative need: an enacted practice can interrupt condemned action where insight alone did not.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The restraining claim about prayer is explicit. The reader relates it to the focus's beautification-diversion chain; the verse does not explicitly present prayer as a historical remedy for ʿĀd or Thamūd, and it may stand as a general instruction.
context_deltas.containment: Do not claim that outward ritual mechanically guarantees immunity from deception or infer the quality of any individual's prayer. State only the contextual contrast between action-forming forces.

context_deltas.reading: The later sudden-punishment sequence introduces temporal asymmetry: people may possess general discernment yet fail to perceive an approaching consequence, whereas their deeds and outcome become unmistakable to later observers.

focus_anchor.role: The addressees' already-achieved clarity is re-read as retrospective clarity after an initially unsensed arrival.

activation_trace.role: Manifest clarity supplies the later observer's position.
Unexpected suddenness supplies the actors' lack of temporal preparation.
Subtle awareness is explicitly negated at the moment of arrival.
Overwhelming encirclement intensifies the contrast between objective exposure and subjective non-perception.
Experiential tasting turns previously performed work into an undeniable consequence.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
structural_cues.role: Sudden arrival is explicitly coordinated with lack of awareness.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
structural_cues.role: The danger is depicted as already encompassing those who nevertheless demand its arrival.

structural_cues.quote_ar: ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
structural_cues.role: The later experience is directly tied back to prior deeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: Suddenness separates general cognitive capacity from timely perception of consequences. Experience and surviving evidence then make the formerly misvalued deeds legible from the other side of the event.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings provide clear evidence, while the former people are simply described as discerning.
changed_reading.after: The clarity belongs to a later temporal position: actors may retain discernment yet not register the imminence or enclosure of the consequence their deeds produce.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Sudden arrival, non-perception, enclosure, and experiential repayment are explicit. The reader applies their temporal pattern to the ancient dwellings; the warned group in 29:53–55 is not explicitly identified with ʿĀd or Thamūd.
context_deltas.containment: Do not assert that the focus peoples had no awareness at all or specify that their historical punishment arrived in the precise manner described later. Qualify this as a temporal analogy.

context_deltas.reading: The closing sequence turns the ancient pattern into a recurrent present dynamic: worldly diversion occupies attention, danger produces exclusive devotion, restored safety permits renewed association, and people can visibly enjoy protected security while trusting falsehood and covering over the favor.

focus_anchor.quote_ar: وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
focus_anchor.role: The ancient combination of attractive occupation, diversion, and sight is mirrored by the later comfort-crisis sequence.

activation_trace.role: Displayed attractiveness supplies the focus-side distortion of attention.
Inner sight supplies the capacity that the later visible facts fail to govern.
Diversion by another occupation supplies an attentional form of being turned from the enduring concern.
Exclusive separation from sharing describes the crisis-state concentration of devotion.
Renewed association after rescue supplies the immediate reversal of crisis clarity.
Seeing by eye or insight makes protected security an available empirical fact.
The shared security-and-trust image binds the secure sanctuary to the question of where trust is placed.
Falsehood lacking truth or stability names the object receiving misplaced trust.
Covering over a favor describes the failure to acknowledge the visible source of security.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَهْوٌۭ وَلَعِبٌۭ
structural_cues.role: The nearer life is characterized by diversion and play.

structural_cues.quote_ar: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
structural_cues.role: The paired temporal clauses display crisis concentration followed by immediate post-rescue reversal.

structural_cues.quote_ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا ءَامِنًۭا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ ٱلنَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ ۚ أَفَبِٱلْبَٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَكْفُرُونَ
structural_cues.role: Visible security and visible surrounding danger are juxtaposed with false trust and ingratitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: Danger temporarily strips away competing supports, while restored comfort permits them to regain attractive force. The sanctuary question then mirrors the focus's combination of visibility and misdirection in the addressees' own present.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a static ancient case of Satanic beautification despite insight.
changed_reading.after: The case becomes a repeatable cycle in which comfort and diversion obscure what crisis discloses, even when protective facts remain plainly visible.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The diversion, crisis devotion, rescue, relapse, visible security, false trust, and ingratitude are explicit. The reader treats their sequence as a mechanism that can instantiate the focus's beautification; a live alternative is to read them as separate polemics against the later addressees.
context_deltas.containment: Do not universalize the cycle into a complete psychology or identify the later speakers historically with ʿĀd and Thamūd. Present it as a supported present analogue.

context_deltas.reading: The chapter's close reverses the focus's blocked path: fabrication and rejection meet truth when it arrives, whereas strenuous commitment is answered by divine guidance into God's ways. Satanic diversion is therefore influential but not coercively irreversible.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: A downstream material analogy overlays the focus's residences and beautified works with a house that visually exists but fails at protection. The result is a reading of deceptive action as building a fragile support-system.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet explicitly targets those who adopt allies besides God and explicitly calls the spider's house weakest. The reader transfers that shelter logic back to the focus's dwellings and works. A live alternative is that the parable applies only to the later ally relation and carries no backward link to ʿĀd or Thamūd.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from historical dwellings and moral action into animal architecture. It remains anchored by the repeated dwelling/shelter domain and appearance-versus-strength contrast, but downstream prose must not equate the peoples' literal buildings with webs or claim that architecture caused their fate.

summary.ordinary_reading: The focus presents ʿĀd and Thamūd as evident cases whose dwellings disclose their consequence: Satan made their intentional deeds look beautiful and thereby diverted them from the way, despite their possession of discernment.
coexisting_readings: The opening tests sharpen discernment into cognition that must be verified by faithful conduct under pressure, while repeated good-work and evil-work formulas show that attractiveness cannot establish moral value.
The invitation to follow a rival way and the false promise to carry another's sins show how diversion can be socially mediated without transferring away responsibility.
Travel, reflective looking, and a deliberately retained clear sign make the dwellings part of a material practice of inference rather than mere scenery.
The surrounding catalogue and its distributive closure place Satanic influence inside a framework in which each party is seized for its own sin and wrongs itself.

Later contrasts among insight, reasoning, inward signs, knowing denial, and correct verbal acknowledgement explain how real knowledge can remain directionally ineffective; prayer supplies a practical restraining counter-pattern.
Suddenness distinguishes general discernment from timely perception, while the comfort-crisis sequence mirrors the ancient failure in present addressees who can see security yet misplace trust.
The final path recurrence reverses blockage with striving answered by divine guidance, so diversion is not presented as coercively irreversible.
Exploratorily, the dwellings may echo cessation of motion after جَٰثِمِينَ, and the spider-house parable may recast beautified works as fragile architecture of apparent security.
unresolved_limits: The focus alone leaves the exact governor of the opening accusatives and the precise event visible from the dwellings implicit; the surrounding catalogue strongly sharpens but does not lexically insert that missing verb into 29:38.

The packet does not specify the particular deeds, the psychological mode of Satanic influence, or whether مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ denotes religious insight, practical intelligence, or a broader capacity for perception.
Several deltas connect distinct historical or contemporary groups typologically; these are reconstructed contextual activations, not claims that every later pronoun refers to ʿĀd and Thamūd.

The cited ك ي ف in 29:20 has no mapped branch and is used structurally only. The packet also records ع ث و and خ ط ط without branches and 29:1 without rooted QAC rows; none of these annotation gaps is treated as lexical absence or filled by an invented branch.
The stillness and spider-house readings remain exploratory and must be presented as echoes or analogies, not as replacements for the ordinary senses of dwellings, deeds, and discernment.
